title: Hard Tears
description: Speeds up the Tears soundtrack to 2x speed and makes it play twice to fill the Time that was saved when speeding it up. For those who like faster music!
body: Speeds up the Tears soundtrack to 2x speed and makes it play twice to fill the Time that was saved when speeding it up. For those who like faster Music. I got the Idea from a Vidio from PhoenixSC, where he sped it up, and I thought it sounded good so I made a Resource Pack for it.
